responsibilities.quote: You must always take responsibility for the work you submit and use AI in ways that uphold academic integrity.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools, when used appropriately, can support you in your learning and research. As a scholar and researcher, you have an obligation to use these tools ethically and responsibly, whilst also ensuring you do not contravene our academic regulations relating to plagiarism, collusion, personation, fraud or cheating
